name: Royal Titans
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategies: attack styles that can damage the boss (generated by scripts/gen-bosses.mjs).
validationNotes: DPS against each phase is covered by the reference validation tests where the rules are modelled. The share of the kill spent on each phase is an assumption; compare the per-phase DPS figures. Branda the Fire Queen, Eldric the Ice King have special damage rules that are not modelled, so DPS is an estimate. Strategies are the attack styles that can damage this boss, best-known first; they are not a strategy guide. Damage-taken weights for Survivability are derived from the attack styles listed for the boss, equally weighted.

requirements.text: Access requirements are not checked by the plugin: see the wiki page

warnings: Only melee is offered: the Titans have very high ranged and magic defence. Elemental and pillar mechanics are not modelled.
Phase weights are assumptions; compare the per-phase DPS figures rather than only the weighted total.
